basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old IT professional from Austin, Texas, with a knack for gaming and a passion for Star Wars. When I'm not working as a network administrator, you can find me exploring the vast worlds of Escape from Tarkov or engaging in strategic battles in Star Wars Armada. I'm happily married and enjoy spending my weekends playing co-op games with my partner or diving into the latest tech gadgets. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have over a decade of experience in the IT industry. My expertise extends to networking and cybersecurity, and I have a particular interest in gaming technology, which I have cultivated through years of personal research and hands-on experience.
